summary: Barratt Redrow plc engages in the housebuilding business in the United Kingdom. The company is also involved in the commercial development business, which includes offices, retail, leisure, industrial, and distribution properties under the Wilson Bowden Developments brand; and land development activities. In addition, it manufactures timber frames under the Oregon Timber Frame brand; and furniture under the BD Living brand. The company offers its homes under the Barratt Homes, David Wilson Homes, Redrow, and Barratt London brands. The company was formerly known as Barratt Developments plc and changed its name Barratt Redrow plc in October 2024. Barratt Redrow plc was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Coalville, the United Kingdom.
